study.question: Does the large added gap-branch gain require context-localized recurrence, or can four pooled elapsed-time edge counts preserve most of it with the same visible history?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g1-r0017-gap_product reaches validation AUC0.630001910 versus parent0.621883703, yet gap association replacements differ by only0.000023347 in product cells and0.000066739 in joint cells. The diagnostics show supported gaps and nonzero witness effects, so this is predictive uncertainty rather than failed execution. Hypothesis: aggregate short/long gap intensity supplies most of the incremental signal; the 4096-coordinate localization and recurrence summaries may be unnecessary for this branch. The source has no true item IDs and singleton support excludes ties. Earlier pooling and energy branches lost quality, so compression remains falsifiable, not a presumed win.

study.proposed_difference: A 2x2 replacement factorial over gap-branch context resolution(local256 vs pooled1) and channel content(all4 vs total1). Construct the incumbent four-channel tensor first, sum over edge contexts for pooled mode, select the total channel for total-only mode, apply log1p/log129, and lift by uniform replication divided by sqrt(replication count) to4096 coordinates. This is a fixed isometric lift of4/16/1024/4096 unique scalar values, not additional information. All four views are computed in all variants, with no new learned parameters. global_total is a mechanism-distinct aggregate-timing replacement, not a new-priority architecture claim. This round tests sufficiency under matched dense-head cost; an efficient compact implementation would need a subsequent controlled measured cost comparison.
predictions: Primary directional prediction: global_total AUC at least0.62919 (retain90% of historical gap gain), within0.0005 of paired local_all; either criterion failing makes the strong sufficiency prediction unsupported.
Removing recurrence channels should have smaller effects than the historical gap-head gain; report both local and global simple effects and the interaction.
local_all features must exactly match the incumbent, with identical constructor allocation and seeded training behavior; a repeat discrepancy indicates host nondeterminism or implementation mismatch.

Host raw-table oracle error<=1e-5 and accumulation/conservation error<=1e-4; global_total has exactly4 unique source coordinates, norm-isometric lift and no target/action dependence beyond identical support.
Synthetic context and recurrence witnesses should separate only views retaining that information; a gap-histogram witness should separate every view while the pre-gap parent remains unchanged.
falsifiers: global_total loses>0.001 AUC versus local_all, or retains<90% of added gap-branch gain; this rejects strong sufficiency for this implementation, not every possible pooling scheme.
Either factor has a stable paired loss across seeds or a large interaction; do not pool main effects and claim all detailed information is unnecessary.
A material Logloss deterioration or populated slice regression contradicts a general claim of preserved predictive quality, even if overall AUC is close.
Any oracle, support, lift normalization, input invariance or incumbent exact-feature check failure invalidates mechanism interpretation until corrected; a compile check is not Torch execution.
No speed/memory reduction follows from lower unique-coordinate count in this matched-compute implementation; no efficiency result is established without measurement.

The global fourth channel includes contextual product aggregation; global_all alone cannot establish pure global timing sufficiency.
